A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''noble''' citizen of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] was living in the [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. He was known to gossip about politics in his favorite [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. On one occasion he blabbed a secret about the [[Minister of Logistics]] and, after sobering, offered up a valuable gift to keep it quiet.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|After Hours}}</ref>
